ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is quadrilateral WXYZ, with the vertices forming a kite shape in the order W-X-Y-Z. Y is above, W is below, X is on the left, and Z is on the right. In the figure, 120° is marked at vertex Y, and there is a right-angle mark at vertex W, so ∠W = 90°. Reasoning: The problem states that WXYZ is a kite. In a kite, the pair of opposite angles located between unequal sides are equal; here these correspond to ∠X and ∠Z, so ∠X = ∠Z. The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is 360°, therefore ∠W + ∠X + ∠Y + ∠Z = 360°. Substituting the known angles gives 90° + 120° + ∠X + ∠Z = 360°, so ∠X + ∠Z = 150°. Also because ∠X = ∠Z, each angle is 150° ÷ 2 = 75°. Therefore m∠Z = 75°.

Thus 90 + 120 + ∠X + ∠Z = 360, so ∠X + ∠Z = 150. Since ∠X = ∠Z, each is 75°, so m∠Z = 75°.

method.method_draft: Read from the image that ∠Y is 120° and ∠W is 90° in the kite WXYZ. From the text, use that WXYZ is a kite. Draw or imagine diagonal WY, the symmetry diagonal of this kite, connecting the top and bottom vertices where the equal adjacent sides meet. In a kite, this symmetry diagonal bisects the angles at W and Y, so in triangle WYZ, ∠WYZ = 120°/2 = 60° and ∠YWZ = 90°/2 = 45°. Then use the triangle angle sum in triangle WYZ: ∠Z = 180° - 60° - 45° = 75°.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是四边形 WXYZ，形状类似风筝；Y 在上方，W 在下方，X 在左侧，Z 在右侧。图中标出顶角 ∠Y = 120°，底角 ∠W 有直角标记，所以 ∠W = 90°。推理：题目给出 WXYZ 是 kite。按图中风筝的对称轴，连接 W 和 Y，得到对角线 WY。风筝的对称对角线 WY 会平分 ∠W 和 ∠Y。因此在三角形 WYZ 中，∠WYZ = 120° ÷ 2 = 60°，∠YWZ = 90° ÷ 2 = 45°。由三角形内角和，∠Z = 180° - 60° - 45° = 75°。
